title: A-Dev Hardness Issue Definition-of-Ready Contract
description: Vendor-neutral structural JSON schema for agent-consumable issues in the AI-SDLC intake phase.

id.description: Unique tracking identifier for the issue (e.g. #104, PROJ-123).

title.description: Structured issue summary conforming to Conventional Commits.

risk_tier.description: Risk authority tier from Hardness Action Risk Model.

context.description: Problem statement, architecture context, and rationale.

objective.description: Single-sentence, unambiguous statement of the target state.

in_scope.description: Explicit positive scope: files and deliverables authorized for change.

out_of_scope.description: Explicit negative scope: surfaces that must not be altered.

acceptance_criteria.description: List of verifiable, binary pass/fail conditions.

context_attachments.description: Repository-relative file paths or durable references.

command.description: Deterministic CLI command used to verify the change.

expected_evidence.description: Expected observable outcome, exit code, or artifact output.

stop_conditions.description: Conditions requiring immediate execution halt and human escalation.
